advice: Experiment: change only the 512-path scratch row pitch and its matching producer and consumer addresses. In the K-loop setup and `Llibxsmm_478`/`Llibxsmm_70c`, advance `x3` by 513*4 bytes per K step and rewind by 512 such steps after each reduction. Update every scratch destination, load stride, rewind, and stack restoration consistently; ensure the padded rows do not overlap and all loads stay within the allocation. Confirm the assembly is legal, the full BSD notice and ABI remain intact, and SME start/stop and stack lifetimes remain balanced. Check n=512 and general, odd-tail, and n<=0 correctness at tolerance 0.002. Use fresh repeated paired controls on the same power source and settings, report spread, and do not infer cache-conflict causality from noisy scores.
